questions.q: What is Valid Panel and how does it work?
questions.a: Valid Panel is a cloud platform where you can open a shop to sell physical or digital products and a social media store to resell social media marketing services. Sign up, choose a plan, customise your storefront, list items or select social media services, connect payments and start selling.

questions.q: Who can use Valid Panel? Do I need technical experience?
questions.a: Entrepreneurs, creators and agencies worldwide can use it. The dashboard is beginner friendly so you do not need coding skills, but developers can extend it through the API.

questions.q: What types of products or services can I sell on my shop?
questions.a: You can list physical goods, digital downloads, licences, subscriptions and services including social media marketing packages.

questions.q: What is the difference between a storefront and a social media store?
questions.a: A storefront is a classic ecommerce website for goods and services. A social media store is a module for reselling social media growth and engagement services such as YouTube views or Instagram followers.

questions.q: Can I run both a storefront and a social media store at the same time?
questions.a: Yes. You can enable both modules under one account and manage them from the same dashboard.

questions.q: How do I create my first shop on Valid Panel?
questions.a: Sign up, click Create Shop, pick a template, enter a shop name, set a domain, configure payments and add your first product.

questions.q: Can I customise my shop's name, URL and branding?
questions.a: Yes. Use the Brand Settings tab to add a logo, colours, fonts and a custom domain.

questions.q: How do I receive payments from my store?
questions.a: Connect a payment gateway in Settings. Funds settle in your gateway account and you can withdraw to your bank.

questions.q: Is my data and customer information safe on Valid Panel?
questions.a: Yes. We use encrypted connections, secure servers and routine security audits. Data is encrypted at rest and in transit.

questions.q: Is Valid Panel GDPR and privacy compliant?
questions.a: Yes. We follow GDPR, CCPA and other global privacy standards. You can generate a Data Processing Agreement inside the Legal Centre.

questions.q: Do you offer tutorials or onboarding help for new users?
questions.a: Yes. We provide step by step video tutorials, a searchable knowledge base and a free onboarding call on request.

questions.q: Can I connect my domain to my Valid Panel shop?
questions.a: Yes. Add your domain in the Domains section and update your DNS records. We issue an SSL certificate automatically.

questions.q: What payment methods can I integrate into my store?
questions.a: Stripe, PayPal, Flutterwave, Paystack, crypto via Coinbase Commerce and manual bank transfer are supported. Availability depends on your country.

questions.q: Can I sell subscriptions or recurring services through Valid Panel?
questions.a: Yes. Choose Subscription when creating a product, set the billing cycle and the connected gateway will bill your customer automatically.

questions.q: Does Valid Panel support international users and currencies?
questions.a: Yes. The dashboard is global and you can enable multi currency pricing with automatic conversion.

questions.q: Can I set different prices for different countries or regions?
questions.a: Yes. Use the Geo Pricing option under Product Settings to create pricing rules per region.

questions.q: Is multi language support available on storefronts?
questions.a: Yes. You can enable built in translations for more than ten languages or add your own.

questions.q: How do I add digital or physical products to my shop?
questions.a: Open the Products page, click Add Product, choose Physical or Digital, upload images or files, set price and stock then save.

questions.q: How do I start reselling social media services?
questions.a: Enable the Social Media Store module, choose a service provider or the built in catalogue, set your markup then publish. Orders are fulfilled automatically through API.

questions.q: Can I automate product delivery for digital goods?
questions.a: Yes. Upload the file once and enable Instant Delivery. Customers receive a secure download link after payment.

questions.q: How does delivery work for physical products?
questions.a: You can print shipping labels from your dashboard or connect a courier API. Tracking numbers are emailed to customers automatically.

questions.q: How do I track customer orders and sales performance?
questions.a: Use the Orders page for real time order status and the Analytics dashboard for revenue, conversion rate and traffic.
